title: UTCS Error Response
description: Three-layer error response: structured code, human-readable message, and machine-actionable recovery hints. UTCS never returns approximate tax or fallback rates — if accurate tax cannot be determined, the response is an error.

category.description: Error category derived from the code prefix.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Clear enough for logging, debugging, and (where appropriate) display to end-users.

recovery.description: Structured guidance for resolving the error. Designed for AI agent consumption.

required_fields.description: Fields that must be provided to resolve the error.

optional_fields.description: Fields that would improve results if provided.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present for retry and retry_or_block actions.

compliance_warning.description: Explicit description of compliance risks if the transaction proceeds without tax determination. REQUIRED for service unavailability errors.

transaction_flag.description: Suggested flag to apply to the transaction if proceeding without determination (e.g., TAX_DETERMINATION_PENDING).
